action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves to find the best reply to Black's c5c3 queen sortie.
action.rationale: Broad search is required and no candidates are pre-verified. Black's queen on c3 attacks the b3 pawn and pressures the back rank; White must address queen activity and the d4/g4 pawn tension. Search all legal roots at depth 4 to identify tactical resources and king-safety issues before selecting a candidate.
